description: Aggressively hunt, investigate, reproduce, validate, categorize, and report software defects in Clypra, a cross-platform Tauri v2 non-linear video editor. Use when asked to find bugs, audit reliability, investigate regressions, review a subsystem for defects, perform an adversarial quality assessment, or identify untested user behaviors and edge cases. Specializes in timeline correctness, audio/video synchronization, preview, rendering, FFmpeg, project persistence, concurrency, React UI, Rust, accessibility, localization, cross-platform compatibility, and packaged desktop behavior.
